channel.title: CHUGAO Field Notes — LED Power Supply Guides
channel.description: Technical guides and factory-field notes on LED power supplies, drivers, IP ratings, certifications, and the 2026 LED market — published by CHUGAO, an LED driver manufacturer in Zhongshan, China since 2008.

item.title: Cable Size & Voltage Drop for LED Installations
item.description: Cable size and voltage drop for LED installations: the 5% rule, max run tables for 12V vs 24V, and three ways to stop dim LEDs at the far end.

item.title: Choosing an LED Power Supply for Outdoor & Harsh Sites
item.description: Choosing an LED power supply for outdoor and harsh sites: the environment ladder from IP20 to IP67, heat derating, dimming and surge in one decision flow.

item.title: Surge Protection for LED Drivers: Lightning & Transients
item.description: Surge protection for LED drivers: where surges come from, the two protective layers, and how to spec a driver that survives lightning and switching transients.

item.title: Power Factor Correction & Flicker-Free LED Drivers
item.description: Power factor correction and flicker-free LED drivers: what PF and ripple mean, where flicker-free is non-negotiable, and how to read the datasheet.

item.title: LED Driver Dimming Explained: 0-10V, PWM, DALI & TRIAC
item.description: LED driver dimming explained: 0-10V, PWM, DALI and TRIAC. What each standard does, which to specify, and why driver and dimmer must match.

item.title: Constant Voltage vs Constant Current LED Driver: Which Do You Need?
item.description: Constant voltage vs constant current LED driver: what each one powers, why mixing them destroys fixtures, and how to read the label before you buy.

item.title: How to Size an LED Power Supply: Wattage, Margin & Inrush
item.description: How to size an LED power supply: add up the real load, apply the 20% margin rule, allow for inrush current and temperature derating — with worked examples.

item.title: 12V vs 24V LED Power Supply: How to Choose
item.description: 12V or 24V LED power supply? How voltage drop limits your cable run, real maximum lengths by cable size, and the simple rule for choosing.

item.title: IP67 vs IP65 LED Driver: Which Rating Do You Need?
item.description: IP67 vs IP65 LED driver: what each rating really protects against, where each one fails, and how to choose the right waterproof power supply for your installation.

item.title: BIS Certification for LED Drivers: India Import Guide
item.description: What India BIS certification means for LED power supply importers. IS 13252 Part 1 requirements, testing process, timeline, cost, and how a BIS-certified supplier like CHUGAO helps you clear customs faster.

item.title: LED Driver Lifespan: MTBF, L70, and How Long They Really Last
item.description: What does 50,000 hours mean for an LED driver? Understanding MTBF, L70 rating, temperature effects, and real-world lifespan of LED switching power supplies.

item.title: Pick the Right LED Power Supply in 3 Steps
item.description: How to choose the correct LED power supply: wattage matching, IP rating for your environment, and input voltage compatibility explained simply.

item.title: IP20 vs IP65 vs IP67 vs IP68
item.description: IP rating explained for LED power supplies: what the numbers mean, where each rating is used, and how to pick the right one for your project.

item.title: 2026 LED Market: What We Are Seeing
item.description: First-hand observations from the factory floor: LED driver demand trends in 2026 — which markets are growing, what specs buyers want most, and how pricing is moving.
